pairs.why: The orange rover has the bright, saturated body color of the real vehicles and smoother moon ground, while the white rover sits on pebbly, more textured terrain, which the lessons mark as off.
Same pair as q008 with sides swapped: the orange rover on smoother ground matches the colorful, clean finish of the real bus and bike better than the white rover on textured, pebbly ground.
The teal-striped igloo with the yellow tube has the cheerful color accents and smoother ground of the real cards, while the all-grey version with scattered rocks looks drab and too textured.
Same pair as q010 with sides swapped: the color-accented igloo on smoother ground is closer to the saturated, clean real cards than the grey one with pebble-strewn ground.
The purple-lit cabin and the man's lighter, warm skin tone match the saturated, warm palette and look of the real character art better than the cooler, washed-out grey version.
Same pair as q012 with sides swapped: the vivid purple version with the warmer, lighter skin tone fits the real cards' saturated, cheerful palette better than the grey, desaturated one.
